description: Déversoir d'orage (déversement temps PLUIE) d'Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes et le bassin Rhône Méditerranée is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Un déversoir d'orage (DO) est un « ouvrage permettant le rejet direct d'une partie des effluents au milieu naturel, lorsque le débit amont dépasse une certaine valeur. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Its keywords include provence-alpes-cote-dazur, open-data, inspire, donnees-ouvertes, deversoir-dorage, occitanie. The listing shows 5 download or service links in UTF8, WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
